name: Stone portal ring
description: A round gate of grey stone, empty inside: a full ring of wedge voussoirs with a proud keystone, set upright on a two-step base of worn slabs between two curved chock stones, every block carved with an angular glyph filled with a faint pale violet glow; moss on the steps.
